target.role: Already-inspected five-stock development target, never untouched holdout

license.status: Public author-published teaching data for local research inspection; no blanket right to redistribute or republish CRSP raw data established. University site and Wiley excerpt retain copyright; no license is inferred from anonymous HTTP access.

sampling_limits: Author-selected five teaching examples, not random or a representative firm panel. Large and long-lived listed firms are overrepresented; sector, size and survivorship selection cannot be estimated from five series.
Different start dates, all ending 2008-12-31, unlike the 2000-2025 French training target. Calendar overlap is not a new held-out target.

No population snapshot, firm-entry/exit coverage, underlying quotes/dividends, permanent IDs or independent audit of adjustments. Provider return convention accepted from primary-source chapter, not reconstructed.
Series and descriptive statistics are now inspected development data. They must never later be described as unseen evaluation data.

target.window_rule: Latest first date and earliest last date across the preselected five files. Require identical observed trading-date lists in that interval; no deletion, imputation or winsorization.
target.return_definition: Decimal simple daily total returns including dividends, per Tsay Chapter 1 section 1.2.5 and Table 1.2; original second-column values, no extra dividends or adjustment
target.observation_operator: Compute all nine moments separately for each company, then take the equal-company mean; never compute moments of a pooled series or a stock basket

bootstrap.method: Circular time-block resampling with the same date index for all five stocks, preserving same-day cross-company dependence; conditional on these selected firms. Only descriptive scaling, no confidence/acceptance test.

fixed_support_constraint.derivation: D>=0 gives r_total>=exp(-c)-1; |log(P[t]/V[t])|<=g gives D/P[t-1]<=(yield/252)*exp(g+c). Bound applies to days satisfying the model guard, and is deliberately loose.
fixed_support_constraint.interpretation: Fixed-cap model cannot reproduce these four observations. This is a support mismatch, not a proof that nine summary moments cannot be approximately matched.

source_scope: Thirteen bare-market, validator, moments, hash and process-tuning files. Parallel disclosure game/domain/financing/policy/metrics/report edits are not dependencies of these simulations.

estimated_cost_before_run.basis: Prior full-size 7539-day bare-market development run took 3.28 seconds of market time. Proportional 6592-day estimate plus moment/serialization overhead, concurrent machine load uncertain.

mechanism_hypotheses.rebalance_speed: Lower speed weakens synchronized portfolio adjustment and price-demand feedback; may change volatility and all ACF/tail moments.
mechanism_hypotheses.order_flow_memory: Higher persistence slows the estimate subtracted from the transient order-flow channel. This changes lagged flow response; memory=1's fixed-zero expectation is outside this predeclared grid.
mechanism_hypotheses.noise_flow_scale: 1.5x baseline demand shock amplitude tests under-dispersion and tail/stability costs jointly with ACF; fixed Gaussian fundamentals and volatility-feedback parameters remain unchanged.

return_definitions.price: P[t]/P[t-1]-1; descriptive sensitivity only because the empirical data are total returns
return_definitions.holder_total: (P[t]-P[t-1]+cash_flow_yield*V[t]/252)/P[t-1]; current model's gross daily holder return including external cash; no invented ex-dividend price correction
return_definitions.economic_limit: V may be a continuing ex-dividend value anchor. Payment without mechanically reducing V/P is not by itself proof of double counting; payout/valuation economic interpretation is unestimated.

acceptance_rules.mechanical: Every candidate, seed, company and day: finite positive P/V, zero official price caps over burn-in and measurement, relative cash error and maximum absolute company-share error <=1e-8.
acceptance_rules.stylized: Every company in every completed seed: all nine finite moments, excess kurtosis>0, abs-return ACF1>0. Report price and holder-total separately; these are generic signs, not empirical calibration gates.
acceptance_rules.empirical: No empirical PASS, p-value or fitted-threshold gate. Report every nine-moment residual, every company distribution, seed variability and support mismatch. Five selected, already-seen stocks are a conditional development sample.
acceptance_rules.descriptive_score: Sum over nine moments of ((mean simulated per-company holder-total moment minus target mean) / fixed target time-bootstrap SE)^2. No chi-square interpretation, optimization, winner/default promotion or candidate selection. Monte Carlo SE from three seeds separately reported, not used to lower the score.
acceptance_rules.failure: Preserve running/failed/capped records and count them. No replacement runs/seeds, no survivor-mean acceptance. Any missing/failed seed makes candidate-level mean matching score unavailable.
acceptance_rules.selection: None. Full fixed grid, no adaptive search. Explicit illustrative configurations are selected before results, not winners.

pairing: Same seed and fixed non-grid parameters share firm/investor initialization and independent fundamental/noise RNG streams. Compare full intrinsic-value path hashes across completed candidates for each seed; failed/capped outcomes remain visible. Pairing is for this bare market, not a general promise for policy-game stochastic clocks.
limits: Company units now match, but author-selected five large/long-lived historical stocks do not identify a representative 200-firm universe or its heterogeneity.
All five full histories already inspected. This matched common window is development data, not an untouched temporal or company holdout.
Three dev seeds reveal local Monte Carlo variability; they do not establish unique structural parameter identification or independent empirical validation.
Same-period shocks common to selected stocks, absent entry/exit/delisting and unknown permanent IDs remain limitations.
Fixed price support and external-dividend economic mapping cannot be repaired by tuning this grid.
